problemStatement.formal: For any NCDistribution μ with freeCumulant μ 1 = 0 and freeCumulant μ 2 = 1, the normalized free convolution powers converge: D_{1/√n}(μ^{⊞n}) → semicircle.
problemStatement.plain: How does the topological CLT perspective (renormalization flow, fixed points, attractors) extend to non-commutative (free) probability? Answer: the semicircle distribution replaces the Gaussian as the unique fixed-point attractor under free convolution and renormalization.
